properties.name: auditagent.scanner.timeout-seconds
properties.description: Maximum wall-clock time allowed for one Semgrep process.

properties.name: auditagent.scanner.heartbeat-seconds
properties.description: Interval between Semgrep liveness progress events.

properties.name: auditagent.agent.max-iterations
properties.description: Maximum number of LLM reasoning iterations before the agent gives up.

properties.name: auditagent.agent.compile-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Timeout in seconds for project compilation commands.

properties.name: auditagent.agent.test-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Timeout in seconds for running unit tests.

properties.name: auditagent.agent.backup-dir
properties.description: Directory (relative to repo root) where file backups are stored before patching.

properties.name: auditagent.agent.max-file-read-lines
properties.description: Maximum number of file lines returned in a single read_file tool call.

properties.name: auditagent.agent.max-retries
properties.description: Maximum number of retry attempts when a patch fails verification.

properties.name: auditagent.agent.llm-call-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Timeout in seconds for individual LLM API calls during the agent loop.

properties.name: auditagent.agent.max-tool-result-chars
properties.description: Maximum characters to store per tool result in conversation memory to prevent context bloat.

properties.name: auditagent.agent.max-history-messages
properties.description: Maximum messages to keep in the conversation history sliding window.

properties.name: auditagent.agent.max-consecutive-empty-responses
properties.description: Maximum consecutive empty LLM responses before aborting the agent loop.

properties.name: auditagent.agent.llm-temperature
properties.description: Temperature parameter for the LangChain4j Bedrock model used in the agentic loop.

properties.name: auditagent.agent.llm-max-output-tokens
properties.description: Maximum output tokens for the LangChain4j Bedrock model used in the agentic loop.

properties.name: auditagent.database.path
properties.description: Path to the DuckDB database file.

properties.name: auditagent.memory.enabled
properties.description: Enable durable memory persistence and retrieval.

properties.name: auditagent.memory.fts-enabled
properties.description: Enable DuckDB FTS BM25 retrieval with metadata fallback.

properties.name: auditagent.memory.retention-days
properties.description: Retention period for redacted message, tool, and error detail.

properties.name: auditagent.memory.context-token-budget
properties.description: Estimated token budget for durable conversation context.

properties.name: auditagent.memory.candidate-limit
properties.description: Maximum repository-memory candidates considered during retrieval.

properties.name: auditagent.memory.top-k
properties.description: Maximum approved repository memories injected into agent context.

properties.name: auditagent.memory.max-chat-chars
properties.description: Maximum persisted characters per redacted chat message.

properties.name: auditagent.memory.max-tool-chars
properties.description: Maximum persisted characters per redacted tool result.
